title: Landing Crosswind Practice Mix
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightlog:entry
| stats avg(crosswind_kts) as avg_crosswind, count as landings by runway_type
| sort - avg_crosswind
description: Shows how much of your recent landing practice includes meaningful crosswind exposure.
value: Practice mix matters because calm-day landings can create false confidence for more demanding conditions.
implementation: Track crosswind estimates and runway type in `index=personal`; compare average crosswind exposure across recent landings.
visualization: Runway-type table of landing count and average crosswind component.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much of your landing practice really includes crosswinds instead of only easy calm-day conditions.
